The DEC-13-2002 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE is canceled, and it is hereby ordered:
This case is set for a case management conference on JAN-31-2003 in Department 212 at 9:00 AM. A
case management statement must be filed no later than fifteen (15) days before the hearing.
Counsel for the plaintiff or plaintiff in propria persona must send a copy of this notice to all parties within five
(5) days of the date of this order.
